comments.author: ScipioHibernicvs
comments.body_html:
This mod (and the other skin mods) are really good. However, I’ve run into an issue with the MARPAT mod - loading into Labs is failing (not a full CTD, I get an error after the map loads and get redirected back to the menu).

Looking into the client logs, there’s a NullReferenceException:

2024-09-04 21:25:19.096 +01:00|0.14.9.1.30626|Error|Default| EXCEPTION: System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object at PoolManager+Class1209.method_1 (EFT.ResourceKey resource) [0x00000] in <a5b6eaefee6842aba73e4a77ea14a564>:0 at PoolManager+Class1209.ConvertResourceInfo (EFT.ResourceKey[] resources) [0x0001f] in <a5b6eaefee6842aba73e4a77ea14a564>:0 at PoolManager+Struct260.MoveNext () [0x000ab] in <a5b6eaefee6842aba73e4a77ea14a564>:0 — End of stack trace from previous location where exception was thrown —Once I removed this mod, I was able to load Labs again.
